why: Analysis 1 correctly stops at a Gate 1 fail, withholds a Hedgehog, ties the hand-loaded single-pharmacy refill feature to network-sourced usage, and names stranger retention as the missing number, with tighter calibration. Analysis 2 has a fuller stop-doing list and an explicit decline-stage table, but it grades Gate 1 as conditional and passes seven gates, layering a BHAG, core values and flywheel onto a product that is not yet good.
